newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: UTENOS LEADS BEER MARKET, OTHER CATCH UP.
newsitem.headline: UTENOS LEADS BEER MARKET, OTHER CATCH UP.

text.p: Lithuania's Breweries Association said on Friday that Utenos Beverages still had the biggest stake of the lucrative beer market in the first quarter of 1997 but others were also competing hard to catch up.

The spokesman for the association, Jonas Martishauskas, told Reuters that Utenos held 29.29 percent of the local beer market in the first quarter of 1997 versus 35 percent in the first quarter of last year.
Kalnapilis grabbed 23.06 percent of the market in the first quarter versus 21 percent in Q1 1996, he said.
Shvyturys of Klaipeda had 18.27 percent of the market versus 15.5 percent, Martishauskas added
Ragutis from Kaunas held 11.74 percent versus 9.9 percent within the same period, he said.
